title: Short Circuit
tagline: Robot on the loose. Snacks on the bench.
about: A military robot struck by lightning comes alive and hides out with a food truck owner.
cue: Serve the snacks when Number 5 starts speed-reading every book in the house.
faces: "Number 5 has read every recipe in the library. This one tastes better than the book said. More, please."
Number 5 getting hit by lightning. Prices subject to change. Images: TMDB.

    StartersNumber 5 popcornPopcorn in two flavours, buttered and salted, and parmesan with cracked pepperHow to make it2 tbsp coconut oil150g popcorn kernels40g butter, melted40g parmesan, finely grated1 tsp cracked black peppersalt, to tasteHeat the oil in a large pot with 3 kernels, covered, until they pop.Add the rest of the kernels, cover and shake until the popping slows.Toss half with the melted butter and salt.Toss the other half with the parmesan and cracked pepper.Stephanie's food truck egg rollsFried egg rolls filled with pork, cabbage, carrot and spring onionHow to make it300g pork mince2 cups shredded cabbage1 carrot, grated2 spring onions, sliced2 tbsp soy sauce12 spring rolls of wrappers1 L vegetable oilFry the pork mince until browned, breaking it up.Add the cabbage, carrot, spring onions and soy sauce and cook until dry. Cool the filling.Roll a spoonful into each wrapper, sealing the edge with water.Heat the oil to about 5cm deep and fry in batches until golden.Drain on paper towel.Oregon coast salted hazelnut brittleThe Oregon coast where Stephanie livesHow to make itAs written, serves 4Toasted hazelnuts set in a thin amber caramel with butter and a pinch of bicarb for crunch, snapped into shards and finished with flaky salt.Toast 200g hazelnuts at 180°C for 10 minutes, rub off the skins and roughly chop.Line a tray with baking paper.Cook 250g caster sugar, 80ml water and 2 tbsp golden syrup in a heavy pan without stirring until deep amber, about 10 minutes.Stir in 30g butter, half a tsp bicarb soda and the nuts.Pour onto the tray, spread thin, sprinkle with flaky salt and cool 30 minutes before snapping.Grilled cheese trianglesNumber 5 read the recipe. Need more input.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.MainsFood truck double burgerSmashed onion beef patties with American cheese, pickles and mustardHow to make it800g beef mince1 onion, thinly sliced8 slices of American cheese4 burger buns1 jar dill pickles1 bottle yellow mustardRoll the mince into eight balls and slice the onion very thinly.Heat a griddle until very hot. Put a few onion slices on each ball and smash flat, onion side down.Flip after 90 seconds, add a slice of cheese and cook briefly.Toast the buns.Stack two patties per bun with pickles and mustard.Nova Robotics chilli cheese dogsThe lab canteen before the escapeHow to make itAs written, serves 4Franks griddled until blistered in steamed buns, smothered with beef chilli, melted cheddar and diced onion, with a stripe of mustard.Brown 300g beef mince with 1 diced onion, add 2 tsp chilli powder, 1 tsp cumin, 2 tbsp tomato paste and 200ml water and simmer 25 minutes until thick.Griddle 8 franks for 6 minutes until blistered.Steam 8 hot dog buns.Fill each with a frank, a spoon of chilli and grated cheddar, then grill 1 minute to melt.Top with diced onion and mustard.SweetsBlackberry cobblerBaked blackberries under a soft biscuit topping, with vanilla ice creamHow to make it600g frozen blackberries130g caster sugar1 tbsp cornflour1 lemon80g cold butter200g self-raising flour120ml milk1 L vanilla ice creamHeat the oven to 190°C. Toss the blackberries with some of the sugar, the cornflour and lemon juice in a baking dish.Rub the butter into the flour and remaining sugar, then stir in the milk to a soft batter.Dot the batter over the fruit.Bake until golden on top and bubbling at the edges.Serve warm with vanilla ice cream.DrinksStephanie's raspberry lemon crushMuddled raspberry and lemon over crushed ice, topped with soda waterHow to make it150g raspberries80ml sugar syrup120ml fresh lemon juice (about 4 lemons)600ml soda water1 bag crushed ice1 bunch mint1 lemon, sliced into wheelsMuddle the raspberries with the sugar syrup in a jug until pulpy.Stir in the lemon juice.Fill four tall glasses with crushed ice and divide the raspberry mix between them.Top with cold soda water, stir gently and garnish with a lemon wheel and mint.Spiced milk chaiFor Ben, still working on the idioms.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
